input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance clause anywhere: there is no insurance heading in the outline, searches for "insurance", "insure", "coverage", "policy" and "shall maintain" return no operative undertaking, and the general/miscellaneous provisions (Sections 13-30, p0078-p0097) and the indemnity section (p0070-p0077) address only indemnity, liability cap, term, assignment, law and venue. TrueLink hosts our Web Site and processes Credit Data and Client Content, so the absence of any cover is walk-away territory under the rule (no insurance for a vendor processing personal data). We therefore insert a short new Section 31 at the preferred levels (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where TrueLink processes Credit Data or Client Content, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request), which also carries the fallback E&O/cyber minima.

ops.text: INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where TrueLink processes Credit Data or Client Content, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. TrueLink shall provide certificates of insurance on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance clause even though TrueLink hosts our Web Site and processes Credit Data, so we have added a short insurance paragraph at our preferred levels (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). We can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if TrueLink's current policies are lower.
proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 31 requiring TrueLink to carry CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy and workers' compensation insurance and to provide certificates on request.
